title: The Heartbreaking Mistake Sellers Make Before It’s Too Late
description:
Most business owners don’t plan to sell under pressure, but life doesn’t always wait for perfect timing.

In this video, I’m sharing what I’ve seen too many times: unexpected illness, sudden emergencies, and missed opportunities that turn a clean business sale into a multi-year scramble.

Here’s what we’ll cover:

✅ Why it’s never too early to start planning your exit
✅ The deal math most sellers forget to calculate (and regret later)
✅ What buyers are really looking for—beyond revenue
✅ How succession planning and team age demographics can change your sale price
✅ The key mindset shift that turns “I’ll do it later” into “I’m ready now”

You don’t need to sell today. But you do need to be ready.
